pages.text:
The latest Land Rover LR2. An even
more purposeful stance. Sportier
and more sophisticated with a new
look front and rear and new wheel
styles and colors, the Land Rover LR2
is ready and prepared to tackle
whatever life throws at it.
Its distinctive exterior is revised, with its sleek lines giving it
a more immediate sense of purpose. There’s an updated interior
with an even greater choice of options and materials, adding
even more excitement to the Land Rover LR2. Land Rover LR2’s
style and engineering deliver refinement, performance and
economy. Pure, state-of-the-art Land Rover.
Vehicle exterior color shown in Ipanema Sand.
3
